description: Renovate's job in this standard is narrow and it is not the same job as
Dependabot's. Dependabot covers the package ecosystems it understands, from
.github/dependabot.yml. What it has no manager for is a version literal
embedded in a shell script or a workflow step -- and the devcontainer
template guarantees you have at least one, because setup.sh installs uv from
a pinned release. A pin no bot can see does not drift; it simply never
moves, and SUP-002 stays green over it.
enabledManagers is custom.regex ALONE so the two bots do not both propose
the same ecosystem upgrade. Widening it produces duplicate pull requests,
which is how a real proposal gets ignored.
Each managed site needs a `# renovate:` annotation directly above the pin.
The annotation is what the manager matches -- these patterns find nothing
without it, and the Dependency Dashboard issue Renovate opens is the only
external evidence they match anything. Derive the expected count from your
own pinned_at entries and check it.

packageRules.description: A checksum-verified tool needs its digests moved by hand
prBodyNotes: **If this tool is verified by `sha256sum -c`, this PR does not update its checksums.** Move every digest the register records in `tools.<tool>.sha256` and every copy at a `pinned_at` site before merging. Leaving them stale fails the install step rather than passing silently, which is the intended direction -- but it fails the build, so do it here.
